# Java 虚拟线程在哪个 JDK 版本正式发布，synchronized 导致的线程固定问题在哪个版本改善？引用 JEP。

以下报告仅综合已通过核验的研究结论，并为每项事实保留可回溯的证据引用。

## OpenJDK JDK 24 · 虚拟线程预览历史

| 491: | [Synchronize Virtual Threads without Pinning](/jeps/491) | [evidence:8cdf097870c72741ab574f39277435e04d4b248679c4112c]

## OpenJDK JDK 24 · synchronized 线程固定改善版本与 JEP

**When running the same example on Java 24, there is no `jdk.VirtualThreadPinned` event being reported**. [evidence:e30ca2aac3bc67582c02b3cf11048916dab9a9f0ea43b5e6]

## OpenJDK JDK 24 · 虚拟线程正式发布版本

A [`jdk.VirtualThreadPinned`](https://openjdk.org/jeps/444#JDK-Flight-Recorder-JFR) event is recorded by JDK Flight Recorder (JFR) whenever a virtual thread blocks [evidence:747746f3818f78ec1d12e9dfe7b4ee5b74cdf7bf0c0c12bc]

## OpenJDK JDK 21 · 虚拟线程预览历史

Unfortunately, a virtual thread cannot unmount when it runs code inside a `synchronized` method. [evidence:62641973963fa45b8c3fec361062918879855236828b1f75]

## OpenJDK JDK 21 · synchronized 线程固定改善版本与 JEP

A virtual thread cannot be unmounted during blocking operations when it is
pinned to its carrier. A virtual thread is pinned in the following
situations: [evidence:c203a226cff4ae665c8271c2e4161028fec138e57b717f43]

## OpenJDK JDK 21 · LTS 状态

JDK 21 will be a long-term support (LTS) release from most vendors. [evidence:b80dd03bde628652f54d0f7aabdf2eebde7c199ed4307bb8]

## OpenJDK JDK 21 · 虚拟线程正式发布版本

在Java 21中，引入了虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）来简化和增强并发性，这使得在Java中编程并发程序更容易、更高效。 [evidence:cd1fa50e94f0818311e30574a390888d033bfac5941e5aba]

- OpenJDK JDK 24 · LTS 状态：必需研究项未找到足够证据

## 引用核对

### | 491: | [Synchronize Virtual Threads without Pinning](/jeps/491) |

- 研究项：`OpenJDK JDK 24 · 虚拟线程预览历史`
- 候选：`dddb7974-06ca-4727-adcf-80ffa2f07710`

  - URL: https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/24/

### **When running the same example on Java 24, there is no \`jdk.VirtualThreadPinned\` event being reported**.

- 研究项：`OpenJDK JDK 24 · synchronized 线程固定改善版本与 JEP`
- 候选：`f6809c17-dcc5-463c-8dfa-c8ae37f75b96`
- Evidence: `evidence:e30ca2aac3bc67582c02b3cf11048916dab9a9f0ea43b5e6`
  - Exact quote: “**When running the same example on Java 24, there is no \`jdk.VirtualThreadPinned\` event being reported**.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/83bddeb4-872d-4619-8cb3-4a3679920e5f/a4c7223eae782ce1d75c2d3ab3a1ff4ec5292d3e647ea95a8ca75f04b19c08a4`
  - URL: https://mikemybytes.com/2025/04/09/java24-thread-pinning-revisited/

### A [\`jdk.VirtualThreadPinned\`](https://openjdk.org/jeps/444#JDK-Flight-Recorder-JFR) event is recorded by JDK Flight Recorder (JFR) whenever a virtual thread blocks

- 研究项：`OpenJDK JDK 24 · 虚拟线程正式发布版本`
- 候选：`78bf0257-78bc-4478-b82f-11a43637a7b6`
- Evidence: `evidence:747746f3818f78ec1d12e9dfe7b4ee5b74cdf7bf0c0c12bc`
  - Exact quote: “A [\`jdk.VirtualThreadPinned\`](https://openjdk.org/jeps/444#JDK-Flight-Recorder-JFR) event is recorded by JDK Flight Recorder (JFR) whenever a virtual thread blocks”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/54d56f9a-5b77-4579-88a1-069a8cffb5e9/572f699c4df331ac997c9f4a96412d8968d7b4cf8f027f3fcb3326946324d8b5`
  - URL: https://openjdk.org/jeps/491

### Unfortunately, a virtual thread cannot unmount when it runs code inside a \`synchronized\` method.

- 研究项：`OpenJDK JDK 21 · 虚拟线程预览历史`
- 候选：`7aa46a34-0038-436e-8e24-e1fe0206c8ab`
- Evidence: `evidence:62641973963fa45b8c3fec361062918879855236828b1f75`
  - Exact quote: “Unfortunately, a virtual thread cannot unmount when it runs code inside a \`synchronized\` method.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/31c83a3c-8d33-45b4-9b2d-8df1fded503f/fb276e6efefd548d5929dd23c76ef0942b0da35dd6484b14c48e82eed2b49bc9`
  - URL: https://openjdk.org/jeps/491

### A virtual thread cannot be unmounted during blocking operations when it is pinned to its carrier. A virtual thread is pinned in the following situations:

- 研究项：`OpenJDK JDK 21 · synchronized 线程固定改善版本与 JEP`
- 候选：`31645c8c-0835-4a51-a898-7730b1d3e078`
- Evidence: `evidence:c203a226cff4ae665c8271c2e4161028fec138e57b717f43`
  - Exact quote: “A virtual thread cannot be unmounted during blocking operations when it is pinned to its carrier. A virtual thread is pinned in the following situations:”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/31c83a3c-8d33-45b4-9b2d-8df1fded503f/e9a290b057612181fef53689f0bf97bfd032a49090d51c8b4cc65408be67cc62`
  - URL: https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/21/core/virtual-threads.html

### JDK 21 will be a long-term support (LTS) release from most vendors.

- 研究项：`OpenJDK JDK 21 · LTS 状态`
- 候选：`b852998b-b2fe-418b-a803-e3922324d26b`
- Evidence: `evidence:b80dd03bde628652f54d0f7aabdf2eebde7c199ed4307bb8`
  - Exact quote: “JDK 21 will be a long-term support (LTS) release from most vendors.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/031b59e0-f44f-4765-80fe-95661950e4bb/5cefe79b531bd5b04f053ccd0d21ce7fc6758d380a09b1d4ff041d5f221f9e7f`
  - URL: https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/21/

### 在Java 21中，引入了虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）来简化和增强并发性，这使得在Java中编程并发程序更容易、更高效。

- 研究项：`OpenJDK JDK 21 · 虚拟线程正式发布版本`
- 候选：`fe31feda-23c6-44ad-a5ea-94dc01038ff0`
- Evidence: `evidence:cd1fa50e94f0818311e30574a390888d033bfac5941e5aba`
  - Exact quote: “在Java 21中，引入了虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）来简化和增强并发性，这使得在Java中编程并发程序更容易、更高效。”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/d1fe15fa-7399-4fdd-bdbd-2a8f4ce32fb8/b5f7a9fe8cb16a08f9e2ece939a73522f27f3e4c7b7754afe3de835a939deef5`
  - URL: https://java.didispace.com/java-features/java21/jep444-virtual-threads.html

## 局限与未解决项

- **OpenJDK JDK 24 · LTS 状态**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- REQUIRED_CELLS_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED
- UNRESOLVED_CELLS_REMAIN

## 完成判定原因

- REQUIRED_CELLS_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED
- UNRESOLVED_CELLS_REMAIN

brief.scope: JDK 19 至 JDK 24 期间虚拟线程的孵化、预览与正式发布状态，以及 synchronized 固定问题的改善版本与对应 JEP。
brief.objective: 确定 Java 虚拟线程正式发布的 JDK 版本，以及 synchronized 导致的线程固定（pinning）问题在哪个 JDK 版本得到改善，并引用对应的 JEP。
exclusions: 不涉及非 OpenJDK 发行版（如 Azul、GraalVM）自有的非标准线程实现
不涉及结构化并发（Structured Concurrency，JEP 453/480/499）等相邻特性的详细评估
brief.deliverable: Markdown research report with citation audit
